Iconger now moves: animations everywhere, plus a few fixes.

**Download `iconger.exe` below**, or just open Iconger v0.5.0: it will offer the update itself.

## New
- **Animations throughout.** Pages fade in and their parts rise in one after another. Open an app and the title, preview, icon choices and details appear in turn; pick an icon and the "New" preview pops in while the app hops in the taskbar preview; the colour sliders cascade in. Cards lift when you point at them, buttons sink when pressed, the sidebar highlight and the "This app / From a file" switch slide, thumbnails fade in as they download, dialogs scale up as they open, and applying an icon gives a small green flourish. If you've turned off "Animation effects" in Windows, Iconger stays still too.
- **Skip this version** in the update dialog: Iconger won't pop up about that version again at startup (you can still update from Settings, and newer versions are offered as usual).

## Changed
- Settings: the "Icon not updating?" card (Restart Explorer) moved to the bottom. Icons apply instantly now, so it's a fallback, not the first thing you need.

## Fixed
- On PCs without the Segoe UI font, text could render with a broken fallback font. Iconger now falls back to Arial or Tahoma properly.

Your backups and settings carry over.
